hero.title: Contact Us
hero.emergencyDisclaimer: If you are experiencing a life-threatening medical emergency, please call 911 immediately or go to the nearest emergency room.

children.text: We are conveniently located on N Elam Rd within the White Rock Medical Center. Free parking is available directly in front of the emergency entrance.

whatToBring.title: What to Bring
checklist: Valid Photo ID (Driver’s License, Passport, etc.)
List of current medications and dosages
Any relevant medical records or history

faq.question: Do I need an appointment?
faq.answer: No, we are a walk-in emergency facility. No appointment is ever needed.

faq.question: What insurance plans do you accept?
faq.answer: We accept most major private insurance plans including Aetna, Blue Cross Blue Shield, United Healthcare, Cigna, and Humana. We also honor in-network benefits.

faq.question: Do you treat children?
faq.answer: Yes, our emergency physicians are experienced in pediatric emergency care, and our facility is equipped to treat children of all ages.

faq.question: How long is the wait time?
faq.answer: Our average wait time is less than 10 minutes. We prioritize rapid assessment and treatment.

faq.question: Are you open on holidays?
faq.answer: Yes, ER of White Rock is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year, including all major holidays.

cta.title: Need Emergency Care Now?
cta.description: Don't wait. Our team is ready to help you immediately.
